name: Crumbling Alcove
description: The eastward tunnel takes a bend to the north, where it becomes a set of slick stone stairs. The trickle of water stems from between the crumbled remains of what was once a burial alcove; there is a rusted metal door leading to the room on the eastern side of the passageway.

features.name: River of Filth
features.details: The mummified corpse of an ancient warrior stirs to life from amidst loose rubble. It is always hostile, and is clad in scraps of what was once a magnificent silk tunic and breeches, with mail coif and iron helm.

features.name: Broken Stairs
features.details: The stairs leading on are slick with moisture and partially crumbled, making them difficult to navigate.

features.name: Sarcophagus
features.details: A weathered granite sarcophagus is partially buried below a pile of rubble.
